description: robot_state, actions, events and RPC methods of MowBite OS over MQTT, as system.api gives them; made from the code, objects sorted by key. x-reasons has severity and resume of every reason by event (COMMAND_REFUSED and REQUEST_REFUSED only in refusals), x-emergency-bits the bits of emergency, x-commands the commands with params, result, the event of their refusal and the actions that do the same, x-methods every RPC method of the OS with its node (planner.* are the planner's, sim.* only in the simulation), x-sensors the sensors by id, x-settings the settings of params.set with the ranges of the OS, x-geometry the keys of robot.geometry.
